observed_effect: NO DEMONSTRATED SELECTOR ADVANTAGE; CAUSAL ATTRIBUTION UNRESOLVED. (1) The controller selector is deterministic but frontier-blind: campaign_controller.py:206-225 ranks OPEN tasks of the expected role by the ordinal tuple (expected_information_gain, downstream_leverage, falsification_power, verifiability, effort, complexity, execution_risk, task_id) and select_task takes candidates[0] (line 311); grep confirms campaign_controller.py never reads state/LEARNING_STATE.md or state/STATE.md (only synthesize_campaign.py references LEARNING_STATE.md). It ranks queue metadata, not the research frontier, so frontier influence is pre-encoded by whoever authors queue tasks. (2) The selector's advantage over prior opportunistic choice cannot be attributed to it yet: global_agent_counter.json shows run 44980089799 is the first production campaign (global 1-10) and campaign_status.json has completed_agents=[]; no controller-selected activation has completed, so no post-selection outcome exists to compare. (3) The selection record is not reconstructible: agent_01_contract.json selection_basis carries a 7-element qualitative_priority vector (the selected task's own rank fields) against a 5-element compared_against id list, so no per-candidate reason is stored; P-001 did outrank P-002/P-004 on falsification_power (HIGH vs MEDIUM) under task_rank, but that is recoverable only by re-running the ranker, not from the durable record. (4) Evidence-backed examples: the pre-campaign frontier-first PRACTICE (agent-selected, not controller-selected) closed six distinct signal classes in about eight activations with no equivalent retest - mean-reversion 37263008074 FALSIFIED, cross-sectional relative strength 37304873966 FALSIFIED, volatility targeting 37314710995 FALSIFIED, momentum 37318950814 SUPPORTED (first admission), cross-sectional momentum lookback 63 FALSIFIED, breakout 37414038601 FALSIFIED - whereas the pre-frontier period spent about ten consecutive activations inside the single MA-crossover family (STATE.md sections from 'real-data pipeline on the collected universe' through 'regime-feature diagnostic') and ended in rejection. That breadth gain is real but confounded: the earlier period was also building the engine, perturbation, universe, and loader layers, and each of its activations still carried a new hypothesis, so the comparison does not isolate the selection mechanism. (5) The durable record of the practice is itself degraded: LEARNING_STATE.md line 12 declares 'Decision: RETAIN (verified)' while its own history rows 51 and 57 record 'UNVERIFIED (process delta)' with no later row upgrading it; the momentum frontier entry is split across a label-only row (line 30) and a status row without a leading pipe (line 32), leaving the momentum status cell blank; activations 37394344201 and the cross-sectional-momentum lookback-63 cell have no logs/ entry; and research/checks/momentum_hold_period_sensitivity.py exists with no artifact and no durable reference.

candidate_tasks.primary_question: Can an agent-record selection rationale make controller task choices auditable without modifying controller code?
candidate_tasks.bottleneck: The controller contract records a 7-field priority vector for the selected task but only a 5-task compared_against id list, so no per-candidate reason for a selection survives in durable state.
candidate_tasks.objective: Determine whether an extra selection_rationale field in agent records, which validate_campaign_agent permits because it rejects only missing required keys, is sufficient to reconstruct why the highest-ranked OPEN task was chosen, using two consecutive agent records.
candidate_tasks.scope: Use state/campaign contracts, existing agent records, and campaign_controller.task_rank only.
candidate_tasks.out_of_scope: Do not modify .github/**, do not add a numeric reward score, do not change the ranking function.
candidate_tasks.deliverable: A durable convention note plus evidence from two consecutive agent records showing whether the selection reason is reconstructible.
candidate_tasks.success_criterion: Either the convention is shown to make selection auditable, or one specific unfixable gap is recorded with the exact missing field.
candidate_tasks.stop_condition: Stop after two consecutive agent records are compared.
candidate_tasks.verification_requirement: Controller-side schema validation plus inspection of the two cited agent records.
candidate_tasks.evidence_basis: Agent 01 audit: campaign_controller.py:206-225 and 307-311 rank static queue metadata; agent_01_contract.json selection_basis carries 7 priorities vs 5 compared_against ids; validate_campaign_agent.py:113-144 rejects only missing required fields.
